# manypkgs ![](reference/figures/manypkgslogo.png)

[manypkgs](https://github.com/globalgov/manypkgs) is a package from the
[many](https://github.com/globalgov) packages universe. It provides
contributors the necessary tools to put their data in the hands of
users. The package includes functions to make this easier to set up a
‘many’ package, import their existing data, and export them in
structures consistent with other packages in the many packages universe.

For more details, please see the
[vignette](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/articles/contributor.html).

## Downloading and installing manypkgs

The development version of
[manypkgs](https://github.com/globalgov/manypkgs) can be downloaded from
GitHub.

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("globalgov/manypkgs")
```

## Cheat Sheet

[![The manypkgs
cheatsheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/globalgov/manypkgs/main/man/figures/cheatsheet.png)](https://github.com/globalgov/manypkgs/blob/main/man/figures/cheatsheet.pdf)

## The many packages universe

The many packages universe aims at making it easier to collect, correct,
and and connect network data across issue-domains of global governance.
[manydata](https://github.com/globalgov/manydata) is the core package
ofnthe many packages universe. The package makes it easy to find,
download, and analyze all the data included in the various ‘many
packages’. For example, the
[`manydata::call_packages()`](https://www.manydata.ch/reference/call_packages.html)
function can be used to discover the packages currently available in the
many packages universe.

``` r

manydata::call_packages()
```

``` R
## # A tibble: 5 × 4
##   Name         Description                                    Installed Latest 
##   <chr>        <chr>                                          <chr>     <chr>  
## 1 manydata     The portal for global governance data          0.9.3     "0.9.3"
## 2 manypkgs     Support for creating new manyverse packages    0.3.0     "0.3.0"
## 3 manystates   Many data on sovereign states                  0.2.0     "0.2.0"
## 4 manytreaties Many data on international agreements          0.0.1     ""     
## 5 messydates   R package for Extended Date/Time Format (EDTF) 0.5.1     "0.5.1"
## Would you like to update manytreaties ? (Yes/no/cancel)
```

Please see [the website](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/) for more
information about how to use
[manypkgs](https://github.com/globalgov/manypkgs) as a developer or as a
data contributor. For more information on
[manydata](https://www.manydata.ch/), please see [the
website](https://www.manydata.ch/).

# Package index

## Setting up

Functions that set up and update a ‘many’ package.

- [`setup_package()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/setup_package.md)
  : Create a new package in the manydata universe
- [`update_package()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/update_package.md)
  : Updates packages of our data universe
- [`add_author()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/add_author.md)
  : Add an author to the current package
- [`add_bib()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/add_bib.md)
  : Add .bib file

## Importing and exporting

Functions that bring data into a ‘many’ package and save it as a
datacube.

- [`import_data()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/import_data.md)
  : Imports and establishes preparation of raw data
- [`export_data()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/export_data.md)
  : Adding datasets to the many packages universe
- [`convert_pdf()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/convert_pdf.md)
  : Get and convert PDFs to text

## Coding agreements

Functions that code identifiers for international agreements.

- [`code_activity()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/code_activity.md)
  : Code Abbreviations for Activity
- [`code_agreements()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/code_agreements.md)
  : Code Agreement Titles
- [`code_known_agreements()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/code_known_agreements.md)
  : Code Known Agreements Abbreviation
- [`code_linkage()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/code_linkage.md)
  : Code Agreement Linkages
- [`code_type()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/code_type.md)
  : Code Agreement Type
- [`condense_agreements()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/condense_agreements.md)
  : Condense similar treatyIDs

## Developing

Functions that help with the development of R packages.

- [`depends()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/depends.md)
  : Loading packages
- [`retain()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/retain.md)
  : Keep objects from the global environment
- [`call_cran()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/call_cran.md)
  : Calling CRAN for the packages of an author
- [`find_undocumented_values()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/find_cran.md)
  [`find_nonascii()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/find_cran.md)
  : Finding what CRAN asks to fix
- [`find_installed_pkg_sizes()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/find_installed_pkg_sizes.md)
  : Finding the sizes of the installed packages
- [`find_transitive_minR()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/find_r.md)
  [`find_required_r()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/find_r.md)
  : Finding the minimum R version that a package needs
- [`group_functions()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/group_functions.md)
  : Grouping the functions of a package
- [`functions_work()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/functions_work.md)
  : Checking whether functions work across different types of objects
- [`print_help()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/print_help.md)
  : Printing a help page to the console
- [`evaluate_bugs()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/evaluate_bugs.md)
  : Getting the GitHub issues of a package
- [`bigo_net()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/bigo_net.md)
  : Analyze Big-O algorithmic complexity of a network function
- [`build_tutorials()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/tutorials.md)
  [`edit_tutorial()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/tutorials.md)
  : Building and editing the tutorials of a package

## Defunct

- [`standardise_dates()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/defunct.md)
  [`standardize_dates()`](https://globalgov.github.io/manypkgs/reference/defunct.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Functions that have been renamed, superseded, or
  are no longer working
